official.application_cycle: 2027 (from 2027 the scholarship provides a 20 per cent fee sponsorship and the number of scholarships increases to 225)
official.status_note: Application status published on the official page: 'Open for automatic consideration' - no application is required.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Scholarships awarded before 2027 provide a 25 per cent fee sponsorship for the duration of the course. From 2027, the scholarship provides a 20 per cent fee sponsorship for the duration of the course and the number of scholarships will increase to 225.
benefits: 20% fee remission (from 2027; scholarships awarded before 2027 provide 25 per cent fee sponsorship)
Benefit for the duration of the course (one or more years)
At least 110 scholarships; from 2027 the number increases to 225
eligibility: Be a citizen of a country with a Gross Domestic Product per capita of US$10,000 or less based on data published by the World Bank (see the eligible countries list)
Have received an offer for an Overseas Fee place in a bachelors degree for commencement in the year the scholarship is offered
Not have previously undertaken tertiary studies (excluding extension studies completed as part of a year 12 program)
requirements: Subject to the Coursework Scholarships Conditions
The scholarship cannot be held with another scholarship or sponsorship that provides a fee sponsorship or discount
Can be deferred to the following academic year
documents: Apply for admission to a University of Melbourne bachelor degree - no separate scholarship application is required
selection_criteria: Offered to the student(s) ranked highest based on their final secondary school or foundation studies results
Selection scores are reviewed annually and may vary between years; scholarship selection is not based on predicted results
coverage: Fee sponsorship for the duration of the course (20 per cent from 2027, previously 25 per cent)
application_method: You are automatically considered for this scholarship, if you have applied for a course
official.application_route: Apply for admission to a bachelor degree; consideration is automatic and successful candidates are notified within five working days of receiving a course offer.
official.citizenship_residency: Citizenship of a country with GDP per capita of US$10,000 or less based on World Bank data
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students (eligible student type: International students; study stage: future study)
official.duration: One or more years (for the duration of the course)
official.description: The Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship is offered to talented students who are enrolling in a bachelor degree and are citizens of countries where international educational opportunities are limited by financial disadvantage. It provides a fee sponsorship (20 per cent from 2027) for the duration of the course, with no separate application required.

verification.notes: The official University of Melbourne scholarships page was fetched directly; the benefit is published as a percentage fee remission (20 per cent from 2027, previously 25 per cent) with no monetary amount, and no English test requirement or application deadline is published.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an automatic-consideration award: apply for admission to a Melbourne bachelor degree and you are ranked automatically, with winners told within five working days of their course offer. The benefit is a 20 per cent fee remission from 2027 (previously 25 per cent), so it reduces but does not cover tuition. The hard gate is citizenship: your passport must be from a country with GDP per capita at or below US$10,000 on the World Bank list, regardless of where you live or study.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Top-performing school leavers from lower-income countries who have just received, or are awaiting, an Overseas Fee place offer at Melbourne
application_readiness_checklist: Check the official eligible-countries list for your citizenship before assuming eligibility
Maximise final secondary school or foundation results, since selection ranks on final results only - predicted grades carry no weight
Confirm you have not previously undertaken tertiary studies (year 12 extension studies are excluded)
Secure the Overseas Fee place offer, as the award requires an offer for the year the scholarship is offered
Plan finances on the basis that the other 80 per cent of fees, plus living costs, comes from elsewhere
common_rejection_risks: Citizenship in a country above the US$10,000 GDP-per-capita threshold, which no strong transcript can overcome
Assuming predicted or conditional results decide the award; only final results are ranked
Holding or accepting another fee sponsorship or discount, which blocks this scholarship
Prior tertiary study outside year 12 extensions, which disqualifies outright
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: With a 20 per cent fee remission from 2027, the remaining 80 per cent of tuition plus all living and travel costs must be funded from other sources.
document_audit: No scholarship-specific documents exist because there is no application; the decisive document is the final secondary school or foundation results transcript
If you hold another sponsorship, get its terms checked against the 'cannot be held with another fee sponsorship or discount' condition before accepting
alerts: The benefit drops from 25 to 20 per cent for scholarships awarded from 2027, while the number of awards rises to 225
Unsuccessful candidates are not notified, so silence after a course offer should be read as a no
Selection scores are reviewed annually and vary between years, so last year's thresholds are not a promise
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for the Melbourne bachelor degree only; ranking and notification are automatic, with outcomes within five working days of the course offer.
